mapper.select: SELECT dataset_id, tenant_id, owner_id, name, purpose, current_revision AS revision, question_count, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_evaluation_dataset WHERE AND dataset_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.dataset_id, r.revision, r.tenant_id, r.owner_id, r.name, r.purpose, r.question_count, r.definition_digest, r.snapshot_json, r.created_at FROM knowledge_evaluation_revision r JOIN knowledge_evaluation_dataset d ON d.dataset_id = r.dataset_id AND d.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND d.owner_id = r.owner_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{caller.tenantId} AND r.owner_id = #{caller.userId} AND r.dataset_id = #{id} AND r.revision = #{revision} AND r.revision = d.current_revision
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_evaluation_dataset (dataset_id, tenant_id, owner_id, name, purpose, current_revision, question_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.datasetId}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.ownerId}, #{row.name}, #{row.purpose}, #{row.revision}, #{row.questionCount}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt})

INSERT INTO knowledge_evaluation_revision (dataset_id, revision, tenant_id, owner_id, name, purpose, question_count, definition_digest, snapshot_json, created_at) VALUES (#{row.datasetId}, #{row.revision}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.ownerId}, #{row.name}, #{row.purpose}, #{row.questionCount}, #{row.definitionDigest}, #{row.snapshotJson}, #{row.createdAt})

INSERT INTO knowledge_evaluation_command (tenant_id, owner_id, key_hash, request_fingerprint, operation, dataset_id, revision, definition_digest, created_at) VALUES (#{row.tenantId}, #{row.ownerId}, #{row.keyHash}, #{row.requestFingerprint}, #{row.operation}, #{row.datasetId}, #{row.revision}, #{row.definitionDigest}, #{row.createdAt})
